note: The title film: one moment from each part of the book.
style: A seventeenth-century French narrative oil painting in the manner of Meissonier and Maurice Leloir: academic realism, exact costume of 1625 (doublets, falling lace collars, wide-brimmed plumed felt hats, bucket-top boots, rapiers and baldrics), warm candlelight and golden daylight against blue Paris dusk, rich glazes, fine brushwork. One single painting filling the whole frame edge to edge; no text, lettering, signature, monogram, border or black bars.

people.dartagnan: D'Artagnan, a Gascon youth of eighteen: a long brown face, high cheekbones, open intelligent eyes, a finely chiselled hooked nose, dark hair to the shoulders, the faint first down of a moustache and no beard; a faded blue woollen doublet, a Béarnais cap with a feather, a long rapier on a leather baldric
people.athos: Athos, a musketeer of about thirty: a noble, handsome, pale melancholy face, dark hair, a small dark moustache, grave dark eyes; the blue musketeer's cassock with the silver cross over a plain doublet
people.porthos: Porthos, a musketeer of giant stature, about thirty: a ruddy laughing face, a magnificent curled brown moustache and small tuft beard, a gold-embroidered baldric and a crimson velvet cloak over the musketeer's blue cassock
people.aramis: Aramis, a young musketeer of twenty-two: a delicate sweet face, soft black eyes, rosy cheeks, a small neat black moustache, white hands; the musketeer's blue cassock with the silver cross, a little clerical in manner
people.richelieu: Cardinal Richelieu at forty: a thin pale aristocratic face, a pointed grey-brown beard and moustache, piercing eyes; scarlet cardinal's robes, a red skullcap, a white lace collar
people.constance: Constance Bonacieux, a young woman of twenty-five: dark hair, blue eyes, a slightly turned-up nose, a fresh pink complexion; a modest dark bodice with a white linen collar
people.milady: Milady de Winter, a woman of twenty-two: pale and fair, long blonde curls falling over her shoulders, large languishing blue eyes, rosy lips, alabaster hands; a dark travelling gown with a lace collar
people.treville: M. de Tréville, captain of the King's Musketeers, about fifty: a hard weathered Gascon face, a grizzled moustache and small beard, keen eyes; a rich dark doublet with the musketeer's cassock and a gold chain

beats.text: Wide: the antechamber of M. de Tréville in Paris, crowded with musketeers in blue cassocks with silver crosses fencing on the great staircase, laughing, swaggering; golden light through tall windows.

Medium: the four friends together, swords raised and crossed in the air, "All for one, one for all", in a Paris street at golden sunset: a young Gascon, a pale noble musketeer, a giant in a crimson cloak, a delicate young musketeer.

Wide: a duel behind the convent of the Carmes-Deschaux in Paris, four musketeers against the Cardinal's Guards in red tabards with white crosses, swords flashing in bright noon light on an empty lot by a high wall.
Medium: Cardinal Richelieu at his desk in the Palais-Cardinal by candlelight, scarlet robes, a quill in hand, cold eyes looking up, a cat on the table, blue dusk at the window.
Wide: a candlelit corridor of the Louvre at night, a young woman in a dark cloak leading a hooded nobleman by the hand past tapestries, a guard asleep.
Wide, far: four horsemen galloping at dawn along a poplar-lined road to Calais, cloaks flying, mist on the fields, a brilliant sky.
Wide: the Merlaison ballet at the Hôtel de Ville in Paris, 1625: a great hall blazing with candles, courtiers in satin and lace, the queen wearing diamond studs, musicians in the gallery.
Establishing, far: the siege of La Rochelle in 1628: the walled port beyond the great royal dike across the harbour, tents, cannon smoke, the sea and a stormy sky. Small figures.
Medium: Milady at night by a candle in a dark chamber, pale and beautiful, a small vial in her hand, her face cold and resolved.
Wide, far: night by the river Lys at Armentières, a lantern on a small boat in the middle of the dark water, figures on the bank, the moon behind clouds.
